contract.increment: Level_ExitAndTerminalTransition adds one after a completed terminal transition when SCENE_STATE is 0x08.
contract.limit: The exit path stops when the count reaches 3.
contract.presentation: SceneResource_RunStatePresentation uses count >= 3 to select the alternate state-8 resource path.

conclusion: FFF006 is a state-8 terminal-transition counter with a shared three-transition presentation threshold.
